title: Chevrolet
summary: Chevrolet, colloquially referred to as Chevy, is an American automobile division of the manufacturer General Motors (GM). Louis Chevrolet (1878–1941), Arthur Chevrolet (1884–1946) and ousted General Motors founder William C. Durant (1861–1947) started the company on November 3, 1911 as the Chevrolet Motor Car Company.

title: Hot Wheels RC
summary: right|300pxHot Wheels RC is a line of remote-controlled Hot Wheels cars introduced in 2020, initially as a Red Line Club exclusive. As the name suggests the series consists of remote-controlled Hot Wheels cars controllable by a remote control. Each car is able to go forward, reverse, turn and activate "boost mode" with a button on their controller.
